findings.location: article.html, paragraph beginning “保罗和西拉在监狱里”
findings.source_quote: When Paul and Silas were in prison, and they were in stocks singing at midnight
findings.suggested_fix: 将“脚上戴着木狗”改为“被戴上脚镣”或“脚上戴着枷锁”，以准确表达被囚禁时戴着刑具。

findings.location: article.html, paragraph beginning “早期教会从希伯来人的犹太传统”
findings.source_quote: Gregorian chant was the dominant form of church music starting around 590 A.D.
findings.suggested_fix: 将“公元590年前后开始”改为“从公元590年前后起”，明确表达该形式从这一时期开始成为主流。
findings.translation_quote: 公元590年前后开始，格里高利圣咏成为教会音乐的主流形式。
